name: Aniline
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database
source.reference: Kooijman and Taylor, ChemSep v8.3, chemsep1.xml (2021), via https://github.com/DanWBR/dwsim (DWSIM.Thermodynamics/Assets/Databases)
source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: Tmax limited to the ChemSep critical temperature 699.00 K (ChemSep: 699.15 K). Tmin raised to the triple point 267.13 K (ChemSep: 263.15 K). A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 93.1265 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 267.13-699.00 K
source.chain: CoolProp 8.0.0: fluid not included; ChemSep, as proposal 0008 sets for the components that are not CoolProp fluids (checked against the NIST WebBook where it has data: vapour pressure)
source.measuredCheck: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/python/check_measured.py): 89 measured values from 29 articles, 288.1-333.1 K; median deviation of the articles 0.47 % (within the 1 % tolerance of the engineering report); largest single deviation -0.62 % at 288.1 K (Soldatovic 2017, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2017.02.007); docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md
